description: Search project memory. What the project already learned from the tickets it shipped — the decisions the team made in answered questions, what QA found, which files a feature lives in, the PR that shipped it, and the requests that were turned down. Every entry is derived from the item's own records (…

item.description: A queue item — its per-project number (e.g. `7`) or full id. Its title and description become the query; its own entries are excluded.

kind.description: What a project-memory entry records. `shipped` — an item that reached `ready_for_qa`/`resolved`: what was asked, what the run found, the files it touched, the PR. `declined` — an item closed `wont_fix`: the request and why it was turned down. `decision` — an answered structured question: what the team picked. `qa` — a QA note or an answered QA question: what "fixed" turned out to mean, or what QA found failing. `outcome` — what a trail's plan achieved against its goal metric: what was tried, the reading, met or missed. A trail's own `decision` entries are its answered questions and its approved plan revisions.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.

paths.description: Comma-separated repo-relative files or directories, e.g. `apps/web/src/checkout/,packages/billing/src/retry.ts`.

trail.description: A trail — its handle (e.g. `T-12`) or full id. Its title, intent and goal become the query; its own entries and its items' are excluded.

name: ops_memory_search
